serve: pnpm --filter indusk-admin build && pnpm --filter indusk-admin start --port 3940

screens.name: new-project
screens.seed: h="${INDUSK_HOME:-$HOME/.indusk}"; [ -f "$h/new-projects.json" ] && cp "$h/new-projects.json" "$h/new-projects.json.looks"; indusk new-project parent "$h/looks-projects" >/dev/null && id=$(indusk new-project start --message "A parental control system for desktop and mobile" --document .indusk/mockups/admin/seed/homework-gate-brief.md) && dir="${INDUSK_HOME:-$HOME/.indusk}/new-projects/$id" && cp .indusk/mockups/admin/seed/homework-gate-proposal.json "$dir/proposal.json" && cp .indusk/mockups/admin/seed/homework-gate-brief.md "$dir/brief.md" && cp .indusk/mockups/admin/seed/homework-gate-creating.json "$dir/creating.json" && cp .indusk/mockups/admin/seed/homework-gate-transcript.jsonl "$dir/transcript.jsonl" && echo $id
screens.unseed: indusk new-project discard {seed}; h="${INDUSK_HOME:-$HOME/.indusk}"; if [ -f "$h/new-projects.json.looks" ]; then mv "$h/new-projects.json.looks" "$h/new-projects.json"; else rm -f "$h/new-projects.json"; fi; rmdir "$h/looks-projects" 2>/dev/null; true
